public_rationale: The exclusive explanation faces material counterevidence: an experiment found that productivity information increased AI adoption in some firms. Its outcome is broader than the generative-AI products discussed here, so it is not treated as decisive. Customer concern about higher charges is documented, but the examined change was paused, and API prices were not reconciled to provider costs. Neither the full claim nor its negation is established on the narrower contextual reading.
limitations: A broader reading covering all AI would make the adoption study more directly contrary evidence.
The firm study is a working paper and its main adoption effect is concentrated in a subgroup.
The pricing account concerns one episode, not every customer or provider.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: AI's popularity comes entirely from social pressure and discounted access; when real costs were charged, customers questioned AI's ROI.

statement.excerpt: The “popularity” of AI has come entirely from social pressure and endlessly-discounted access, and the very second that they charged the actual costs, their customers started freaking out and kvetching about whether AI has ROI.

from_speaker: entirely from social pressure and endlessly-discounted access
the very second that they charged the actual costs
our_interpretation: The context primarily concerns generative AI products, particularly coding tools. Popularity means adoption and continued use.
Entirely is an exclusive causal assertion: practical usefulness or other independent drivers must not contribute to adoption.
The very second is read as a prompt customer response, not a literal second-by-second deadline.
Actual costs means prices covering the relevant provider costs. A switch to published API prices does not by itself establish this.
The second clause asserts that a pricing event happened; it is not treated as a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Credible causal evidence attributes adoption exclusively to social pressure and discounted access, and dated records establish prompt ROI objections following verified cost-covering prices.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible evidence establishes an independent adoption driver within the claimed product scope, or directly refutes the asserted cost-covering pricing event and customer response. Evidence of usefulness alone does not establish an adoption cause.
